notes: English identifies the legendary Summer Fae witch who leads the spiders in Webwood and attacks Canneroc. Japanese ウィドウ and Chinese 寡妇 corroborate the same character. Use the distinctive transliteration 위도우(The Widow), not the generic Korean noun 과부. This record covers the explicit source form The Widow only. Do not register Widow as a global English alias: standalone Widow also occurs as an ordinary spouse term and in the separate place Seven Widow Mine; review short forms contextually.
